messages.plaintextBody:
James,

On the £4m, the family interests will put in £3.0m and I'll subscribe £1.0m, all at completion. Can you confirm the funds flow treatment and what board/shareholder resolutions we need? We'd like it structured so it counts towards the covenant cure if ever needed.

Robert

messages.subject: RE: Project Willow - new equity mechanics
messages.plaintextBody:
Robert,

Confirmed - £3.0m / £1.0m split, applied per the funds flow (TLA prepayment £2.0m, fees, costs, and ~£1.54m retained for working capital). We'll need a board resolution and a shareholder resolution authorising the allotment; Elena will circulate drafts with the board pack. The subscription will be documented as subordinated shareholder funding so it qualifies for the equity-cure mechanic.

James
